title: I'm making a stylish tetris game - Want Feedback
author: CareerExtension1145
selftext:
Hi r/aigamedev ,

This is a game I've been working for a while now, it's still in development. I've been working on it for the past 2/3 months.  
I started it to see if I could do a tetris game with a twist, like abilities and with persona 5 style of animations, tho the abilites are not that many and the animations are now different than what I've started with.  
I've been lurking in the tetris sub and found a lot of things that needed to be done for the gameplay too that I didn't know also.  
This is the first project I've been really focussing to get things kinda right. I've had some personal projects that, when I started vibe coding, from 1 year ago, that were kinda cool at the time, but now I see them having a lot of problems, while doing those I learned a lot of things and now I want to get out my first real game. It's in active development, there are the patch notes too of the things that I change in every patch so people know what happens.   
If you can give me some of your feedback, the gameplay, the feeling of the game, what to change, what you like, what you don't like. Wheter to publish, etc.  
The game is made in React, Typescript on Google Ai Studio since it's useful to build it in a web browser.

Thank you in advance, have a nice day!   
The game is here: [https://neon-blocks-one.vercel.app/](https://neon-blocks-one.vercel.app/)

comments.author: Undumed
comments.body: There is a big delay between the inputs and the actions, it feels so janky

replies.author: CareerExtension1145
replies.body: Thank you for the feedback, how it feels janky? Like because of the delay of the actions after the inputs and/or something else?

replies.author: Undumed
replies.body: The delay, yes, I dont want to wait a second to see the tetramino rotating, its even worse when u press 2 times the rotation action and the tetramino ends up not rotating at all.

replies.author: CareerExtension1145
replies.body: Okay, thank you again for the feedback, I appreciate it! I tried to push a patch to adjust the delay/animations for the tetramino, now it's more snappier/instant. It should not have problems rotating 2 times as well. Also there's a 180° rotation button the key "2".

comments.author: Sufficient-Pop-1643
comments.body: I'd suggest adding dynamic acceleration when holding the down arrow key (S) and making the S(Z)-shaped figures jump a bit when pressing W—it's confusing.
